top_signals.title: Ukraine Welcomes Restored U.S. Intelligence Amid Russian Attacks
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he is thankful to the US as intelligence on Russian missile strikes "works now," after talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Oslo. Zelenskyy had previously said that Washington had temporarily paused some intelligence sharing with Kyiv before resuming it. "We are thankful that intelligence works.... I'm speaking about early warning, what is very important for our people, for children, adults, civilians, because we can hear when ballistic [missiles are] coming," Zelenskyy told reporters…

top_signals.title: Trump Administration Pushes Refiners to Boost Diesel Output as Prices Soar
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy has called on refiners to ramp up their diesel fuel production further, Reuters has reported, citing two high-ranking officials from the department. There are talks ongoing with refiners both in the United States and abroad, the report said. This is the latest move on the part of the federal government to push diesel prices down from all-time highs, with the national average stuck above $6 per gallon. top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
